tips.text: Aim Orb of Deception so it hits the enemy on the way out and again on the way back; the return hit is true damage.
Charm stops at the first enemy it hits, so line it up where minions are not in the way.
Land Charm first, then follow with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception; the fox-fires go for a charmed champion first.
Cast Fox-Fire to clear minions that are low on health; it deals extra damage to them and gives you a burst of Move Speed.
Use Spirit Rush to reposition and fire bolts at the same time. Keep a recast ready to escape or to finish a fight.
Take a kill on an enemy you just damaged to heal with Essence Theft, and that also extends your Spirit Rush recasts.
Play safer while Spirit Rush is on cooldown, because Ahri has much less escape and survivability then.
Aim Charm through a gap with no minions in front of Akali. Once she is charmed, finish her with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception.
Stay away from Akali's Five Point Strike at its tip range. Fight her when her energy is low and she cannot spam it.
When Akali goes invisible in Twilight Shroud, hit the smoke with Orb of Deception. Area spells still reveal her.
Save Spirit Rush for escaping Akali's Perfect Execution at level 6 and above. Your health is low once her second dash is coming.
Aim Charm at Akshan when he swings in or walks up to trade; it stops him and sets up your Orb of Deception and Fox-Fire.
Stay behind minions so Akshan cannot easily hit you with Avengerang; Charm also stops at the first enemy it touches, so keep that in mind when you aim.
Hit Akshan with Orb of Deception both going out and coming back; the return pass does true damage.
Look for Akshan when he vanishes with Going Rogue; he cannot attack or cast without revealing himself, so keep your abilities ready.
Use Spirit Rush to dash away after a trade, or to finish a weakened Akshan.
Stay behind minions so Anivia's Flash Frost is harder to land; she needs it for her stun and her Frostbite damage.
Use Orb of Deception to poke Anivia from range, but don't walk into her Glacial Storm.
Throw Charm when Anivia has used Crystallize badly, or wait until the wall melts; the wall can block the kiss.
Look for a kill when Anivia is low, but know her egg means a second life. Finish the egg quickly, or fight when it is already used.
Hit Annie with Orb of Deception when she steps up to last-hit. It damages her on the way out and again on the way back.
Check Annie's Pyromania counter. When it is full, stay out of her Disintegrate and Incinerate range, because her next spell stuns you.
Keep Spirit Rush ready for when Annie stuns you or Tibbers lands. It is your way to escape.
Land Charm on Annie when she is out of position. Then Fox-Fire chases her and hits harder.
Land Charm on Aurelion Sol before you commit; he is a slow caster and a charmed target cannot cast Singularity or Falling Star.
Walk out of the Falling Star area as soon as you see it land; it hits after a delay, so you can dodge it.
Do not stand in the middle of Singularity; it drags you inward. Step out of the circle early.
Use Orb of Deception to poke him while he waits for his abilities, and pull the orb back through him for a second hit.
Use Spirit Rush to dash out of his Breath of Light beam or away from his Astral Flight chase.
Aim Charm at Aurora when she hops back after The Weirding; it stops at the first enemy hit, so line it up so no minion stands in front.
Stay behind minions when Aurora has The Weirding ready, so it is harder for her to hit you.
Once Charm lands, follow with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception while Aurora cannot dodge.
Do not chase Aurora after Across the Veil; she turns invisible. Wait for her to show again, then use Charm.
Keep Spirit Rush ready for escaping, since you are much easier to kill without it.
Aim Charm at Azir whenever you can. Once he is charmed, follow up with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception while he cannot act.
Stay out of the range of his Sand Soldiers. They hurt a lot over a long fight, so trade quickly and step back.
Charm stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep minions out of its path or Azir will be safe behind them.
Use Orb of Deception to poke him when he steps up to last-hit. It passes through units, so minions do not block it.
Hold Spirit Rush as your escape. Azir's wall can block you, so dash away before it lands.
Keep minions between you and Brand's Sear; it hits only the first enemy, and the stun needs you ablaze.
Charm Brand when he steps up to poke or farm; he is easy to hit once he commits to a cast.
Walk out of Pillar of Flame's area as soon as it appears; it has a short delay before it erupts.
Use Fox-Fire's speed boost to leave range after Brand lands a spell, before his combo can finish.
Don't stand beside your minions when Brand has Conflagration; it spreads to them and further if you are ablaze.
Hit Brand with Orb of Deception when he walks up for a trade; it hits him on the way out and the way back.
Keep Charm for when Briar leaps in; it knocks her down and stops her trade.
Poke with Orb of Deception while Briar is out of her leap range, and throw it again as it returns.
Stay behind minions so Charm is hard for the enemy to land on you, and keep your distance from Briar.
Use Spirit Rush to dash away when Briar locks onto you in her frenzy, then fire Fox-Fire as you retreat.
Aim Charm at Cassiopeia when no minions are in the line. Charmed, she can't dodge, and you can follow with Orb of Deception and Fox-Fire.
Stay out of Cassiopeia's Miasma clouds. They slow you and ground you, so you can't dash out with Spirit Rush.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as she casts Petrifying Gaze. You get slowed and not stunned.
Orb of Deception has long range, so poke Cassiopeia with it. Both passes hit her if she stands at the end of its path.
Don't stand poisoned in front of Cassiopeia for long. Her Twin Fang hits much harder and heals her.
Aim Charm at Diana before she reaches you; it stops her dash-in and sets up Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception.
Stay behind your minions so Diana can't reach you easily, and Charm hits the first enemy it meets, so line it up with no minion in the way.
Keep Spirit Rush ready when Diana goes in on you; its dash gets you out of her reach and its bolts hit back.
Diana's Pale Cascade shield soaks your damage while the orbs spin; trade after it fades or after the orbs have gone off.
When Diana is hit by Crescent Strike she is revealed and can dash again quickly, so back away from her when she is marked.
Throw Charm at Ekko when he dashes in or walks up to the wave; the stunned-free window is yours, so follow with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception.
Keep minions between you and Ekko's Timewinder trades? Better: stay out of its long line, since its return hit hurts more than the first.
Charm stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it on a clear line and not through minions.
Watch for the image Parallel Convergence leaves on cast and walk out of the area before it arms. Do not stand in it.
When Ekko's Chronobreak is down, he is much easier to trade with and kill, so look to go in then.
Do not chase Ekko into a fight he can rewind out of; save Spirit Rush until Chronobreak is spent so you can finish him.
Land Charm first, then use Orb of Deception and Fox-Fire on the charmed Ezreal. Charm makes the rest of your combo much easier to land.
Ezreal is fragile, so look for the all-in once you have Charm ready. Walk up with Fox-Fire for extra speed and to pressure him.
Keep minions between you and Ezreal so Mystic Shot hits them first instead of you. It stops at the first enemy it hits.
Ezreal can use Arcane Shift to dodge Charm. Bait it out first, then throw Charm when it is on cooldown.
Aim Charm at Fizz when he walks up to trade or to dash in. He can't escape the Orb of Deception follow-up while he is charmed.
Hold Charm until Fizz has used Playful. While he is untargetable he can't be hit, so wait for him to land.
Stay behind minions so Fizz can't walk up for free. Charm stops at the first enemy it hits, so use it only on a clear line.
Use Orb of Deception to poke Fizz when he walks up for minions. The damage on the way back can't be reduced by armor or magic resistance.
Keep Spirit Rush ready to escape Fizz at level 6. Dash away from his Chum the Waters once the fish is on you.
Move sideways when Fizz throws Chum the Waters. It attaches to the first champion it hits, and the shark comes up two seconds later.
Use Charm from behind minions; it ends on the first unit it hits, so line it up on Galio with a clear path.
Do not fight Galio when his Shield of Durand is charging; his magic shield and damage cut blunt your magic damage. Poke when he isn't charging.
Stay out of Justice Punch's long line when it is ready, and don't get stuck close to him; it knocks you up.
Hold Spirit Rush to get away from Galio's combos, since he cannot dash through walls.
Hit Hwei with Charm when he commits to a slow spell, then follow with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception while he can't move away.
Keep moving and stay out of straight lines. Hwei has to guess where you will be, and most of his spells are slow to land.
Rush Hwei right after he casts a Torment spell. He is easy to catch then, so trade with Spirit Rush and Orb of Deception.
Stay out of long range from Hwei, because his lightning hurts most when you are alone or can't move. Don't stand still when you're hit by his roots or pulls.
Step out of the explosion after Hwei hits you with two different spells. It goes off after a short delay and lands where you were hit.
Land Charm on Irelia as she dashes in. A Charmed Irelia can't use Bladesurge, and you can follow up with Orb of Deception and Fox-Fire.
Don't spend Charm on Irelia while she charges Defiant Dance. She resists the damage and keeps her recast.
Poke Irelia with Orb of Deception while she has no minions to dash to. She has fewer ways to reach you.
Keep Spirit Rush ready to escape when Irelia dashes onto you. Dash away and fire Fox-Fire as you go.
Stay out of the line between the blades of Flawless Duet. Being stunned there is the start of a deadly combo for you.
Throw Charm from behind minions' reach only when the line is clear. Kassadin ignores unit collision, so he can walk through minions to dodge it.
Do not rely on Charm to trade early. Kassadin can use Null Sphere to shield himself, so poke with Orb of Deception instead.
Orb of Deception deals true damage on its way back, so it ignores his magic resistance. Use it to hurt him without trading.
Keep Spirit Rush ready for when Kassadin jumps in with Riftwalk. Dash away after he has committed.
Push the wave and punish him early, before he reaches level 6 and Riftwalk gets stronger.
Stay out of Force Pulse range. It slows you, so you can't easily dodge his follow-up.
Aim Charm when Katarina walks up to a Dagger, because Shunpo is on cooldown.
Keep Spirit Rush for when Katarina dives you. It lets you dash away from Death Lotus.
Charm Katarina while she channels Death Lotus. It interrupts her.
Keep Orb of Deception on her Daggers when they land; she often steps in to pick them up.
Hit LeBlanc with Charm to cancel her Distortion return. She is stuck where she dashed and takes your full combo.
Use Orb of Deception to poke LeBlanc whenever she walks up to last-hit. It hits her on the way out and again on the way back.
Stay behind minions so Sigil of Malice and Ethereal Chains are harder to land cleanly.
Once Ethereal Chains hits you, break the tether by walking out of range, or you will be rooted.
Keep Spirit Rush ready for when LeBlanc dives. It gets you out of her burst and your bolts hit back.
Throw Charm from behind your minions or from max range. Lissandra's Ring of Frost is her best answer when you get close, so stay out of its reach.
Hit Lissandra with Orb of Deception on its way out and again on its way back. Both passes deal damage, and it is a safe poke from range.
Watch for Glacial Path. Lissandra can jump to the claw, so Charm her when she recasts it, or hold Charm for when she lands.
Do not stand next to Lissandra in a fight once she reaches level 6. Frozen Tomb can stun you where you stand, so keep Spirit Rush ready to escape.
Trade when Ring of Frost is on cooldown. Lissandra has little to stop you from walking up with Fox-Fire and Charm.
Keep minions between you and Lux. Light Binding only roots the first two enemies it hits, so avoid lining up with a minion behind you.
Land Charm on Lux, then follow with Orb of Deception and Fox-Fire. She has no dash to escape.
Step out of Lucent Singularity before it bursts. Don't stand in it, or you get slowed and hit.
Move sideways when Lux's Final Spark warning line appears at low health. It reaches very far.
Aim Charm through the lane to hit Malzahar while his Void Shift is down, since it blocks crowd control. Once he is charmed, follow up with your other abilities.
Stay out of Malzahar's Call of the Void line, because being silenced stops you from dashing out or casting.
Do not stand near minions carrying Malefic Visions; when they die it spreads to you.
Keep Spirit Rush ready when Malzahar is near, because it lets you escape his Nether Grasp range or position safely.
Kill his Voidlings with Fox-Fire, and push the lane so Void Swarm gets less use.
Wait until Mel has used Rebuttal before you throw Charm; her nova destroys enemy projectiles, so it can wipe out your key spell.
Stay behind minions when Mel is ready to cast Solar Snare. It is a long-range shot that you can dodge by keeping out of its line.
Do not fight when your health is low and Mel has been hitting you. Her Overwhelm stacks can execute you, so back off for a moment to let them fall off.
Use Fox-Fire after Mel's nova has gone. Its flames home in on her and keep your trade going.
Once Mel is stunned or tied up with no way to answer, hold Spirit Rush for the kill. Save it so you can escape afterward.
Land Charm on Naafiri when she commits to a dash, then follow with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception while she cannot act.
Stand behind minions so Charm cannot be thrown back at you easily, and keep Naafiri from closing in; Charm stops at the first enemy it hits.
Use Orb of Deception from long range to hit Naafiri and her packmates on both passes.
Keep Spirit Rush ready when Naafiri is near; she can burst you fast, and you need the dash to escape.
Fox-Fire hits what is near you, so use it when Naafiri and her packmates jump on you; it also speeds you away.
Aim Charm from behind your own minions' sides or when none are between you. It stops at the first enemy it hits, minions included.
Hit Orianna with Orb of Deception on its way out and again on its way back. The return pass deals true damage.
Stay out of Command: Shockwave range once Orianna reaches level 6, especially when the Ball is near you. It pulls you in and she wins the trade.
Orianna's abilities only reach where her Ball is. Stand away from it and she has to spend a cast to move it.
Use Fox-Fire after landing Charm; the flames go for the charmed champion first.
Aim Charm at Qiyana when she dashes toward you with Audacity or Terrashape; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep minions out of the line.
Once Charm lands, follow with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception while she is stuck. Fox-Fire goes for charmed champions first.
Use Orb of Deception to poke her when she walks up to farm. It hits twice, on the way out and on the way back.
Keep Spirit Rush ready when Qiyana is near. It lets you escape her burst, and you are much easier to kill without it.
Watch for Qiyana's ultimate near walls and brush. Stay away from terrain when she has Supreme Display of Talent, since it stuns you around its edges.
Aim Charm when Ryze walks up to last-hit, with no minion between you. It hits the first enemy in its path.
Stay away from Ryze while he has Flux on you. Rune Prison then roots you and Overload hits harder.
Poke with Orb of Deception from long range, since it hits on the way out and again on the way back. Ryze has to come close to hit you.
Save Spirit Rush to escape or finish a fight. Without it you are far easier to catch.
Land Charm on Sylas before he lunges in; it stops his trade and sets up Orb of Deception and Fox-Fire.
Stay behind minions so Sylas cannot easily land Abduct; his chains hit the first enemy they meet.
Do not stand where Chain Lash is aimed. Step sideways when the chains cross, because the blast comes a moment later.
Hold Spirit Rush when Sylas is low; his Kingslayer heals him, so finish him fast with Fox-Fire and the bolts.
Be careful using Spirit Rush near Sylas at level 6. He can steal it with Hijack and use it against you.
Aim Charm at Syndra when she has just used Scatter the Weak; her long cooldown leaves her with no way to push you off.
Stay behind minions so Syndra cannot hit you easily. Charm stops at the first unit it hits, so keep a clear line to her.
Walk around the Dark Spheres lying on the ground. If Syndra uses Scatter the Weak on one, it stuns you.
Use Fox-Fire for the move speed when you step in or out of her range. It also hits her without any aiming.
Trade with Orb of Deception when she steps up to last-hit. It damages her on the way out and again on the way back.
Stay out of Taliyah's Unraveled Earth field when you can; her Seismic Shove can knock you into the stones and stun you.
Taliyah's Threaded Volley flies in a straight line, so sidestep it rather than walking away along its path.
Look for Charm when Taliyah has used Seismic Shove; it is slow to come back. Follow up with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception.
Use Orb of Deception to poke Taliyah from long range; it hits her on the way out and again on the way back.
Keep Spirit Rush ready as your escape. Dash away if Taliyah's Unraveled Earth or Seismic Shove catches you.
Aim Charm at Talon when he leaps in or walks up to you. Charm stops at the first enemy it hits, so line it up clear of minions.
Keep Charm ready for his dive. Once it lands, Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception hit him much more easily.
Save Spirit Rush to get away after he commits. Without it you are easy for him to burst.
Watch the map when Talon leaves lane, since he roams well. Push the wave first so he loses minions, then follow or warn your team.
Fox-Fire is a good way to harass him when he steps up to last-hit. Its speed boost also lets you retreat.
Talon is weaker when Shadow Assault is down, so trade harder then. He then has no easy escape from you.
Land Charm on Twisted Fate, then follow with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception. He cannot answer once he is charmed.
Stay out of melee range when Twisted Fate is shuffling Pick a Card; the Gold Card stuns and the Red Card slows you.
Watch for Twisted Fate's Destiny. When he uses it, expect him to teleport in, so keep Spirit Rush ready to escape.
Sidestep Wild Cards as it fans out; its cone is wide, so step out of the angle early.
Use Fox-Fire to speed away or close in on Twisted Fate after he spends his cards.
Charm Veigar when he steps forward, then follow up with Orb of Deception and Fox-Fire. He is fragile and dies fast once caught.
Keep moving when Dark Matter is cast at you, because it lands after a delay. Sidestep it once you see where it will fall.
Never walk through the edge of Event Horizon. Stand inside the cage or stay outside it and you won't be stunned.
Trade back once Veigar has spent Event Horizon or Dark Matter, and keep Spirit Rush ready to get out afterward.
Don't dash at Vex while her Doom 'n Gloom is ready; her next ability will fear you and interrupt the dash. Wait until she has spent it.
Land Charm on Vex when she steps forward to trade. It is a long-range shot that stops at the first enemy, so keep minions out of its path.
Sidestep Mistral Bolt. It speeds up and narrows after a short distance, so move out of its path early.
Use Orb of Deception to poke Vex from long range, and hit her on both the way out and the way back.
Vex's Personal Space shield is short-lived. Hold your damage a moment until it fades.
Land Charm on Viktor before he can set up Gravity Field; a charmed Viktor can't cast anything back.
Stay out of Gravity Field. Staying inside it long enough stuns you, so walk out as soon as it lands.
Sidestep Hextech Ray; it is a thin line and slow to travel, so you can often walk out of it.
Stay behind minions so Viktor's Siphon Power and Hextech Ray are harder to land on you while you farm.
Use Orb of Deception to poke him when he steps up to last-hit, since it hits on the way out and back.
Use Fox-Fire after a Charm, because the fox-fires go for a charmed champion first.
Move out of Arcane Storm early; it follows you, so use Spirit Rush to get away from it.
Land Charm on Vladimir while he's away from minions; it is your main way to start a trade, and then Fox-Fire follows up.
Hold Charm until Vladimir uses Sanguine Pool; he can't be targeted in it, and waiting makes the pool cost him health.
Don't stand in Sanguine Pool; it slows you and hurts. Step out or back off until it ends.
Poke with Orb of Deception while Vladimir is last-hitting, but expect his Transfusion to heal him back.
Kill Vladimir before Hemoplague bursts, or move out of its area; it heals him.
Stay out of Xerath's line when Shocking Orb is ready; step sideways or hide behind minions. The orb keeps going past minions, so don't count on them.
Close the gap on Xerath quickly with Fox-Fire's speed boost. He is weak up close.
Land Charm on Xerath when he is charging Arcanopulse. He moves slowly then and can't dodge easily.
Use Orb of Deception to hit Xerath on the way out and back. Dodge his Eye of Destruction by walking out of the circle before it lands.
Use Spirit Rush to jump out of Rite of the Arcane's blasts, or to reach Xerath. Watch his cast animation and start dodging.
Keep Charm for when Xin Zhao dashes in or walks up. Stopping him before his combo finishes ruins his trade.
Poke with Orb of Deception while he is far away; both passes hurt, so hit him on the way out and back.
Hold Spirit Rush to escape his all-in. His Audacious Charge slows you, so dash away early.
Use Fox-Fire for burst of speed to step out of his Three Talon Strike hits.
Aim Charm when Yasuo walks up to last-hit; the first enemy it hits is charmed, so keep minions out of its path.
Hold Charm until Yasuo's Wind Wall is used or has faded, because the wall destroys projectiles that hit it.
Yasuo's Wind Wall has a long cooldown, so after he spends it, go for your full combo.
Throw Orb of Deception through Yasuo both ways; it hurts on the way out and on the way back.
Stay away from minions when Yasuo has two Steel Tempest stacks; his next one is a whirlwind that knocks you up from range. Dodge it sideways.
Fox-Fire gives you a burst of speed, so use it to slip away after a trade or when Yasuo dashes at you.
Hold Spirit Rush for escaping when Yasuo threatens to dash onto you; you are much easier to kill without it.
Throw Charm at Yone when he steps up to trade or farm; once he is charmed, follow with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception.
Charm stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it along a lane clear of minions or it will be wasted on them.
Poke with Orb of Deception from long range so Yone has to walk into it, and make him pay for last-hitting.
When Yone dashes in with his third Mortal Steel, use Fox-Fire for the move speed and to back away from him.
Keep Spirit Rush ready to dodge out of his Fate Sealed or to chase after you charm him. Without it you are easy to catch.
Use Charm on Yone's body or when he is in spirit form; he has to come back, so trade damage back at him before he returns.
Hit Zed with Charm when he steps up to trade or to place a shadow; he is stuck in place and you can follow with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception.
Charm stops at the first enemy it hits, so wait for a clear line to Zed; a minion in front of him will block it.
Use Orb of Deception to poke Zed whenever he walks to last-hit; it hits on the way out and again on the way back.
Keep Spirit Rush ready for when Zed uses Death Mark on you. Use it to dash away from the shadow and the follow-up damage.
Punish Zed right after he spends Living Shadow; his damage and mobility are low until it returns. Charm him then.
Fox-Fire gives you a burst of Move Speed; use it to step out of his Shadow Slash range after he engages.
Stay out of Zoe's Sleepy Trouble Bubble range and sidestep it. If you fall asleep, any hit on you deals extra damage.
Punish Zoe when she uses Portal Jump. She can't move while there and must return to her start, so hit her with Charm.
Aim Charm carefully, since it stops at the first enemy hit. Keep minions out of its path, and walk wide of them.
Hit Zoe with Orb of Deception on the way out and again on the way back, especially when she steps up to poke.
Once Zoe is charmed, follow up with Fox-Fire and Orb of Deception for a quick, strong trade.
